'''Sense Ta-Ree''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to to detect the ambient Ta-Ree in a given location. It could not be used to detect [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, but there were other forms of life on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]] that could detected by the spell.
